correctness.rationale: For connected support the edgewise Laplacian map is injective. Trace-inverse on the positive-definite 1-perp space is strictly convex in the individual weights; logdet is strictly concave, guaranteeing unique optimizers. Matching-preserving automorphisms then force uniform x on matched edges and y on others, despite unrestricted weights. Eigenvalues 0,2[x+(m−1)y],my(m−1),[2x+(m−2)y](m−1) give A and D objectives. Boundary derivatives under budget produce the exact rational r_A and r_D. Independently verified symbolic threshold identity, strictly positive factorization of r_A−r_D, m=4 values 56/29 and 10/7, both critical gamma/m limiting derivatives and 12 full exact-rational Laplacian spectra at m=3..8. Strict convexity on original linear budget parameter proves global uniqueness, not a numerical optimizer alone.
